name: Uwe Sandner
headline: CTO | CPO | Building ventures and platforms from greenfield to scale
summary:
Visionary and results-oriented executive (CEO/CTO/CPO, Managing Director, Product & Engineering) with 20+ years of experience shaping the future of digital. I specialize in leading organizations through complex transformations, leveraging emerging technologies like AI and Low-Code platforms, and building robust Cloud Infrastructure. My approach integrates strategic thinking with hands-on expertise in Modern Engineering, Product Management, and Design Thinking. I have a proven track record in Venture Building, navigating M&A and PMI processes, and ensuring rigorous Compliance. As a dedicated coach and servant leader, I build and scale sustainable, high-impact teams grounded in data, trust, and transparency. Passionate about translating innovative ideas into monetizable digital solutions that deliver exceptional customer value.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Elevion Green transforms decarbonization into a profitable business strategy through Energy as a Service (EaaS) and advanced Contracting models. As part of the Elevion Group, we provide a "one-stop shop" for integrated renewable ecosystems in several countries, combining high-efficiency photovoltaics with Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We manage the entire lifecycle—from conceptualization to full realization—enabling companies to achieve energy independence and cost-optimization without CAPEX complexity.
- Built a greenfield digital B2B platform from zero to launch for the Elevion Group, empowering businesses with renewable energy solutions. Held full P&L and operational responsibility for product, technology, and infrastructure.
- Architected and launched a transformative B2B platform, digitalizing end-to-end processes including marketing, sales, EPC, and value-added services. This included deep integration with existing CRM and ERP landscapes.
- Championed and implemented innovative AI and low-code technologies, resulting in demonstrable uplift in conversion rates and substantial reductions in operational process costs.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
Qwist offers a full-stack Open Banking platform. It enables partners to connect to over three thousand financial institutions across Europe and Middle East, access accounts, and enrich transactions with data & analytics tools, creating new value from financial data.

- Led the entire technology function for a leading independent OpenBanking SaaS provider, serving clients across the EU and MENA regions.
- Drove the development and delivery of core OpenBanking solutions, including Account Information Services (AIS), Payment Initiation Services (PIS), and advanced data enrichment capabilities (leveraging ML for categorization, contract recognition, insights, and risk indicators).
- Successfully implemented these services by integrating with diverse data sources via PSD2 APIs, web scraping techniques, and premium APIs across multiple European and MENA markets.
- Engineered and operated a secure, private hybrid cloud infrastructure spanning multiple datacenters (bare-metal, AWS, GCP) and client-side deployments, ensuring compliance within a highly regulated environment.
- Played a pivotal technology leadership role in strategic business initiatives, including acquisitions, financing rounds, post-merger integrations (PMI), and the ultimate sale of the company.

company.name: Elevion Green
company.tagline: Wir machen aus Klimaschutz einen Business Case.
company.description:
Elevion Green macht Klimaschutz zum Business-Case. Die B2B-Plattform befähigt Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland, mit schneller, durchdachter und unkomplizierter Installation von Photovoltaik-Anlagen und Batteriespeichern Kosten zu sparen – dank günstiger Sonnenenergie. Die Unternehmen gewinnen dadurch Freiheit mittels dezentraler Energieversorgung, die Gemeinschaft profitiert von der Dekarbonisierung.

Elevion Green ist ein Angebot der Elevion Group, zu der mehr als 80 spezialisierte Unternehmen in über 13 europäischen Ländern gehören. So kann Elevion Green als „One-Stop-Shop“ von der Beauftragung bis zur Realisierung alles aus einer Hand anbieten.

Das Unternehmen Elevion Green mit Sitz in Berlin wird von dem Geschäftsführer Daniel Netušil geführt.
